Admin Monitor 🛡️

Monitor registered public/student accounts on this Memora installation.

Important: This single-file version stores accounts in the browser's localStorage. That means the admin can monitor accounts created on the same browser/device. For a real public website where the admin can see users from different devices, a server/database such as Firebase, Supabase, or your own backend is required.
